what: nón rộng vành, the wide hat of straw or cloth that women wear against the sun
uses: Plan 0026, R10: women on the walk of the sea and on the sand, in place of the nón lá for some. A person of the person blueprint of World, 1.6 m tall: the sizes are for that body, and they scale with it.

photos.date: 2019-04-30 (in the file name of the photo)
photos.author: Tuổi Trẻ
photos.shows: The beach of Bãi Trước full of people at the end of the afternoon, to the south: people on the sand and in the water, swim rings, a light blue lamp pole, Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu, the stepped block, the orange tile roof, the hill Núi Nhỏ.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: Two women who sell food by the low wall of the beach: rough grey granite blocks, square posts, a top rail and an opening between two posts; a woman in a nón lá stands beside the wall; a bicycle.
